pictureTalk.indigenousText: Maolah tayra kongkoan kako. Minanam miconga, mitilid, lomadiw, masakero. Malipahak kako to romiamiad. Makapah ko micongaan no mako. Mafana'ay kako a mitilid, mansa maolahay ko singsi takowanan. I tini i loma' i, o wina to, o wama, o kaka to fa'inayan, o safa to fafahiyan i, sahetoay maolah mitengil to kalomadiw no mako, minengneng to kasakero no mako.
pictureTalk.chineseText: 我喜歡去學校，學畫畫、讀書、唱歌、跳舞。我每天都很高興。我畫的圖很漂亮。我(也)很會讀書，老師很喜歡我。在家裡，爸爸、媽媽、哥哥、妹妹全都喜歡聽我唱歌、看我跳舞。
